paywall_subscribe_body: In-app billing will be connected here.
delete_account_alert_message: Are you sure you want to permanently delete your account? This action cannot be undone and you will lose your subscription.
delete_account_requires_relogin_message: For security reasons, please sign in again and then try deleting your account.

delete_account_not_signed_in: No active session. Please sign in again.
driver_online_desc: When off: no order notifications and no location broadcast.
wallet_empty_sub: Completed deliveries will appear here and add to your balance.
auto_mode_desc: Automatically switch platforms based on demand
nav_need_location: Turn on location to start delivery.
choose_language_subtitle: This is shown only on first launch
nav_settings_hint: Driving mode is recommended for turn-by-turn in the city. Map and marker update instantly when you change these options.
better_platform_desc: Wolt paying +18% more than Glovo now
completed_orders_will_appear: Completed orders and earnings will appear here
driver_assistant_hint: Enable system access so DriveMind can read Uber/Bolt notifications and on-screen trip info. No auto-taps.
perm_screen_subtitle: DriveMind requires three Android permissions to show live order ratings and read order details from Uber, Bolt, Glovo, and Wolt.
perm_all_granted: All permissions granted — bridge is active
perm_overlay_desc: Allows DriveMind to show real-time order profitability in an interactive widget over Uber, Bolt, Glovo, and Wolt while you review offers.
perm_a11y_desc: Allows DriveMind to read order details — price, distance, and addresses — directly from the Uber, Bolt, Glovo, and Wolt screens. Strictly read-only; DriveMind never taps or interacts with those apps.
perm_usage_desc: Allows DriveMind to detect which delivery app is currently in the foreground so it knows when to activate the order scanner.
perm_info_privacy: Order data is processed locally on the device to compute profitability. Minimal account details, subscription status, and navigation routing preferences are transmitted securely to Firebase and Google Maps Platform services.
perm_info_pill: When an order appears, DriveMind instantly shows an interactive widget with profitability so you can decide without switching apps.
perm_info_refresh: This screen refreshes automatically when you return from Android Settings.
perm_alert_msg: To analyze orders instantly, please enable Accessibility and the Interactive Widget overlay permission.
perm_android_only: Native permissions are Android-only. No action is required on this platform.
onboarding_role_title: Are you a Taxi Driver or Courier?
onboarding_role_subtitle: We tailor DriveMind to your daily workflow.
onboarding_widget_desc: The helper widget appears only when you open your work apps to show you real-time profit analysis.
onboarding_widget_body: The Interactive Widget is context-aware and appears only in supported driver apps, so your phone stays clean and distraction-free.
onboarding_permissions_a11y_desc: Required to read order details and calculate your income instantly.
onboarding_permissions_overlay_desc: Required to show the Interactive Widget on top of your driving apps.
onboarding_value_subtitle: Professional tools built for your role.
onboarding_disclosure_privacy_intro: Order data is processed locally on the device to compute profitability. Minimal account details, subscription status, and navigation routing preferences are transmitted securely to Firebase and Google Maps Platform services.
onboarding_disclosure_a11y_desc: DriveMind uses the Accessibility Service to read order details (price, distance, destination) shown in partner apps. This on-screen order data is processed locally on your device and is not persistently stored in the cloud.
onboarding_disclosure_overlay_desc: Overlay permission is used to display the Interactive Widget on top of your work apps.
krakow_mocks_hint: Labels rotate like Uber/Bolt in PL/UA/RU/EN
dashboard_isolation_body: Map hidden. Complex animated and navigation map layers are temporarily disabled.
searchStatusBlocked: 🔒 Activate subscription to search for orders
subtitle: Reach your destination with maximum margin thanks to automatic profit calculation
feature1Sub: Instant preview of order profitability before accepting
feature2Sub: The widget automatically hides when opening the DriveMind app
feature3Sub: Monitoring Uber, Bolt, Glovo, and Wolt in the background without ads
pricingSub: First 7 days: 0 PLN. Then automatic renewal.
footerLegal: Cancel anytime in the Google Play Store. Subscription renews automatically until cancelled.
